name: Dog daycare
summary: How expats evaluate dog daycare in Singapore — temperament assessments, group vs spa-style days, transport add-ons, and condo pickup constraints.
body:
Dog daycare gives social exercise when owners work long office days. Reputable centres run temperament assessments before group play; not every dog is a fit. Transport vans and condo lobby rules often decide convenience.

## Decision points
- Assessment / trial day requirements
- Group play vs quieter enrichment days
- Vaccination and sterilisation policies
- Pickup / drop-off windows and van routes
- Peak holiday booking freezes

Ask what happens if your dog cannot join group play after assessment.

## How to choose
Prefer centres that explain supervision ratios and incident reporting. Tour the play areas if allowed. Confirm overtime fees when meetings overrun pickup.

## Practical tip
Do a mid-week trial before a travel week. First-day fatigue and diarrhoea are common — better at home than mid-trip.
